svg.title: The SmartDesign canvas of the Catalog route, with numbered callouts that light up in turn: the register core placed from the Catalog, CoreAPB3 which also came from the scratch vault, and the master core, which is still an HDL core placed from the Design Hierarchy.
svg.desc: The SmartDesign canvas of the Catalog route, with numbered callouts that light up in turn: the register core placed from the Catalog, CoreAPB3 which also came from the scratch vault, and the master core, which is still an HDL core placed from the Design Hierarchy.

g.text: pfdaq_demo_regs_C0 is a configured copy of the vault core; APB_TARGET and AXIS_INITIATOR are bus pins, as for the HDL core.
The scratch vault started empty, so the vendor core was added to it with the same command.
The master is plain Verilog of this project, placed from the Design Hierarchy.
